A husband from Lombok, Indonesia, and a wife from Japan,
together with their family,
share culture, daily life, food, and parenting across both countries.

about.title: About Lombok-Japan Family
about.body:
We are an international family living with care
for both Japanese and Indonesian cultures.

Through our videos, we share family life and rural living,
cultural differences between Japan and Indonesia,
food and parenting,
and moments spent with loved ones.
about.storyBody: Cherishing life in both Lombok and Japan, we share culture, food, parenting, and everyday moments on camera.
